question: Does a separate leverage multiplier applied after the frozen BRRK-0011 corrected 0-1 defensive scaler improve after-cost compounded wealth without violating the preregistered operating drawdown, tail-risk, stress, liquidation-distance, benchmark, funding-cost or implementation-robustness constraints?

architecture.master_plan_formula: BRRK directional weights × frozen defensive_scale × leverage_multiplier = final target economic exposure
architecture.risk_off_monotonicity_rule: For a fixed leverage_multiplier, lower frozen defensive_scale may never produce higher final gross exposure.
architecture.cap_1_parity_gate: At research cap 1.00, leverage_multiplier is identically 1.0 and the complete path must reproduce the frozen BRRK-0011 <=1 baseline before any >1 result is valid.

only_structural_change.rule: Do not extend or reinterpret the frozen corrected defensive selector above 1.0. Preserve V1 relative weights, HMM, semantic states, filtered posterior, state-return fit, Student-t family, defensive-scale formula, 20 percent scenario tail budget, P3.3 rebalance semantics and P3.4 contribution handling.
only_structural_change.forbidden_shortcut: Do not obtain >1 gross by changing the upper bound of the frozen defensive selector.

search_above_1_30_rule: Requires a new experiment ID and preregistration before execution.

tail_risk.rule: The frozen defensive layer remains responsible for its existing 20 percent scenario CVaR/CDaR gate. The leverage layer may not weaken that gate and must additionally satisfy full-path operating/stress constraints.

objective.primary: maximize after-cost long-run compounded terminal wealth / CAGR

mandatory_benchmarks.description: BTC buy-and-hold on the matched evaluation window
BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB equal-weight buy-and-hold on the matched evaluation window

benchmark_rule: Every material candidate result must report all three mandatory benchmarks using matched windows and clearly labeled metric/cost conventions. Promotion cannot rely only on comparison with the frozen BRRK baseline.

transaction_cost_treatment.rule: Candidate and frozen BRRK baseline use identical matched transaction-cost assumptions. Benchmark-specific unavoidable costs must be reported separately rather than silently normalized away.

native_panel.name: HYPERLIQUID_NATIVE_COMMON_WINDOW
native_panel.rule: Use Hyperliquid native funding for actual perp exposure / leverage overlay on the common window. Do not charge spot exposure perpetual funding.

binance_proxy.role: sign/regime/full-history stress proxy only; never a Hyperliquid level estimate

funding_spike_stress.method: multiply the absolute observed native funding debit on perp exposure while preserving its debit direction
funding_spike_stress.rule: If the native observation is a credit, do not turn the stress into a larger favorable credit; clamp the stressed contribution at no better than the observed credit and report separately.

funding_treatment.missing_data_rule: Missing required native funding evidence is not zero-filled and blocks promotion.

router_and_instrument_rule.baseline_exposure: Use the frozen P2 router economics for base long exposure where historical evidence supports the route.
router_and_instrument_rule.leverage_overlay: Gross exposure above unlevered economic exposure is derivative/perp overlay only.
router_and_instrument_rule.all_perp_role: Allowed as a conservative stress panel, not the sole primary implementation economics.

synthetic_market_stress.execution_rule: No favorable same-day rebalance is assumed inside a one-day gap shock.

scenarios.name: PARTIAL_FILL_50_PCT
scenarios.unfilled_remainder_rule: remain at prior exposure until next legal decision; do not assume favorable immediate completion

degraded_fill_stress.capacity_rule: Reuse P2.3/P2.4 capacity semantics: if required notional cannot be supported by stressed available depth, the candidate fails that implementation scenario rather than assuming an executable fill.
degraded_fill_stress.no_double_count_rule: VWAP/slippage degradation and generic bps stress must be itemized so the same impact is not silently counted twice.

liquidation_distance.acceptance: No modeled liquidation in mandatory historical or synthetic stress. Minimum adverse-move distance to modeled liquidation must exceed the largest applicable preregistered one-day gap stress for the evaluated position mix.

selection_rule: Do not select the best in-sample CAGR point. Prefer a broad neighboring region with strong terminal wealth, robust Calmar/Sharpe, non-knife-edge drawdown sensitivity and lower gross cap when economics are comparable.
promotion_success_conditions: cap=1.00 exactly reproduces frozen BRRK before any >1 candidate is considered
all three mandatory benchmarks are reported on matched windows
after-cost compounded wealth is strictly higher than frozen BRRK at matched 5 bps and 10 bps cases
candidate is not dominated by frozen BRRK at 20 bps
selected operating drawdown budget is respected
70 percent catastrophe boundary is never breached
frozen 20 percent defensive scenario CVaR/CDaR gate is not weakened
all mandatory historical, synthetic gap/volatility, funding-spike and degraded-fill scenarios pass
liquidation-distance evidence passes and missing venue evidence fails closed
start-date and stationary-block robustness thresholds pass
candidate uses no funding alpha/filter, shorts, XRP target, EXPOSURE-SMOOTH-0038 substitution or P5 exit logic

deployment_cap_rule.rule_if_promoted: Live cap must be the next lower preregistered cap grid point than the selected research cap and may never exceed 1.20 under LEVERAGE-0040. A selected research cap of 1.10 therefore implies live cap 1.00.

stopping_rule: Run the preregistered cap/budget/cost/funding/stress/robustness suite once after cap=1 parity. Do not retune after seeing results. Material changes require a new experiment ID.
forbidden: run LEVERAGE-0040 before this preregistration is committed
run any >1 candidate before cap=1 exact baseline parity
extend or reinterpret the frozen defensive selector above 1.0
change BRRK-0011 relative targets, HMM/regime features or defensive-scale formula
change the frozen 20 percent scenario CVaR/CDaR budget
search above gross 1.30 under this experiment ID
add shorts or XRP target exposure
authorize production leverage or production trading
required_result_artifacts: selection/failure decision with no post-result retuning

hypotheses.H1: A separate post-defensive leverage multiplier with cap in (1.0,1.30] improves matched after-cost compounded wealth while satisfying the complete preregistered gate.
hypotheses.H0: No cap above 1.0 satisfies the complete gate; preserve the frozen <=1 baseline.
